_about: v2.4 plan 08 T18 per-role calibration, curator role (the WI curator's real prompt + parser + the review planner). Labels frozen 2026-09-25 BEFORE any model answer was read. A 'change' case lists the entries whose state the story has overtaken; each required item passes when a surviving review record (planCuratorProposal, mode review) names that entry with one of the listed kinds. A 'none' case passes only when no record survives. 'forbidden' entries must never carry a surviving record. Floors are in 08-author-observability.md section 'Per-role calibration floors' and in `floors` below; they are never retuned. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case instead.

cases.label: change
cases.why: enable: the party entered the place the entry describes

scope.objective: Find the way through the old mine.
scope.canon: The party left the river camp at dawn. Bel lit the brass lantern and led them into the collapsed mining tunnel under the hills. The camp is far behind them now.
openArcs: Where does the tunnel come out?

entries.content: A collapsed mining tunnel under the hills. Damp, narrow, lit only by what the party carries.
Bel is the party's guide, a former miner who knows the hills.

cases.label: change
cases.why: the siege the entry describes is over

scope.canon: After nine weeks the besieging army broke camp and marched north. Three days ago the siege of Varn was lifted and the city gates were thrown open. Traders are already coming back through them.

entries.content: The city of Varn is under siege. Its gates are shut and nobody goes in or out.
The market square sits at the heart of Varn, ringed by stalls and a stone fountain.

cases.label: change
cases.why: the person the entry names as commander is dead

scope.canon: Captain Hale was killed in the ambush at the fish market. Sergeant Brin took command of the harbor watch the same night and has already doubled the patrols.

entries.content: Captain Hale commands the harbor watch. He is stern but fair, and he answers to the governor.
A crowded harbor of fishing boats and merchant ships, busy from dawn to dusk.

cases.label: none
cases.why: every entry agrees with what has happened

scope.canon: Mira and Tolan reached the delta at dusk and hired the ferryman Oskar to take them across the reeds.

entries.content: A drowned plain of reeds and channels between the salt flats and the sea. Only a ferry crosses it safely.
Oskar is an old ferryman who charges one silver coin per crossing.

cases.label: none
cases.why: stable geography; nothing the story did touches it

scope.objective: Reach the monastery before the snow.
scope.canon: The travellers left the valley village and began the long climb up the switchback road. The wind is picking up but the road is still clear.

entries.content: A narrow road that zigzags up the mountain to the monastery. It closes when heavy snow falls.
A stone monastery near the summit where monks shelter travellers for the night.

cases.label: change
cases.why: enable: a legend the party has now witnessed

scope.objective: Find out what rings beneath the lake.
scope.canon: At midnight the party heard a bell ringing from under the black water of Lake Morrow, exactly as the villagers' old story says. Nobody has rung a bell there in a hundred years.

entries.content: Village legend: the chapel bell sank with the old village when the valley flooded, and it rings before a death.
A deep, cold lake that flooded the old valley village a century ago.

cases.label: change
cases.why: the shop the entry describes burned down

scope.objective: Find out who started the fire.
scope.canon: Last night a fire gutted Orin's shop on Candle Lane. Nothing is left but a blackened shell, and Orin is staying with his sister across town.

entries.content: Orin's shop on Candle Lane sells lamp oil and rope. It is open every day from dawn.
A narrow lane of tradesmen's shops in the old quarter of Ashgate.

cases.label: none
cases.why: an off entry about a place the story is nowhere near

scope.canon: The crew arrived in the southern port city and spent the day asking captains along the docks about passage east.

entries.content: A frozen desert far to the north where nothing grows.
The busy docks of Southport, where ships from every coast take on cargo and passengers.

cases.label: change
cases.why: a festival the entry says is happening tonight is over

scope.objective: Track the thief through the empty city.
scope.canon: The Festival of Lanterns ended four days ago. The streets are empty again, the paper lanterns have been taken down, and the thief has gone to ground.

entries.content: The Festival of Lanterns fills the streets tonight: crowds, music and thousands of paper lanterns.
A masked thief who steals only from the city's moneylenders.

cases.label: none
cases.why: style bait: terse but accurate text is not a change

scope.canon: The riders stopped at the Grey Mare inn for the night and stabled their horses.

entries.content: Roadside inn. Stables. Cheap beds.

cases.label: change
cases.why: two changes: the vault is now in play, and the guards the rotation describes are gone

scope.canon: The crew slipped past the drugged guards, who are asleep in the guardroom, and reached the vault door. The guard rotation will not resume until the morning shift.
openArcs: Can Vex crack the inner lock?

entries.content: A steel vault with a dial lock and an inner door that needs two keys.
Guards patrol the vault corridor every hour, day and night.

cases.label: none
cases.why: a long entry shown in part, still accurate: no rewrite

scope.canon: The scholars entered the Great Archive and asked the archivist for the charter records. She sent them to the reading room to wait.

entries.content: The Great Archive holds every charter, deed and ledger the city has issued in four hundred years. Its reading room is open to scholars with a seal from the university, and the archivist decides which records may be brought out. Records older than two centuries are kept in the lower vaults, where no lamp may be lit and a clerk must carry each volume up by hand. The archive has burned twice, and both times the lower vaults survived intact, which is why the city keeps its founding charter there. The archivist, a patient woman named Sela, has held the post for thirty years and knows where almost everything is kept, though she rarely admits it.

cases.label: change
cases.why: habilitar: el grupo bajó a la cripta

scope.canon: El grupo movió la losa detrás del altar y bajó por la escalera de piedra hasta la cripta. Las antorchas apenas iluminan los nichos.

entries.content: Una cripta húmeda bajo el altar, llena de nichos con los restos de los antiguos abades.
El abad Tomás dirige la abadía y desconfía de los forasteros.

cases.label: change
cases.why: el alcalde que nombra la entrada huyó

scope.canon: El alcalde Ruiz huyó del pueblo con el dinero de los impuestos. El consejo nombró alcaldesa a Vega, que ya ha cerrado la taberna por orden suya.

entries.content: El alcalde Ruiz gobierna el pueblo desde hace diez años y todos le temen.
La plaza del pueblo, con una fuente y la iglesia al fondo.

cases.label: none
cases.why: todas las entradas coinciden con lo ocurrido

scope.objective: Subir a lo alto del faro.
scope.canon: Los viajeros llegaron al faro al anochecer. El farero Anselmo les abrió la puerta y les ofreció sopa caliente.

entries.content: Un faro de piedra blanca sobre el acantilado, con una escalera de caracol de doscientos peldaños.
Anselmo es el farero, un viejo amable que vive solo en el faro.

cases.label: change
cases.why: la tormenta que describe la entrada ya pasó

scope.canon: La tormenta pasó durante la noche. Esta mañana el mar está en calma y los pescadores ya han vuelto a salir.

entries.content: Una tormenta azota la costa: olas enormes y ningún barco puede salir del puerto.
Un pequeño puerto pesquero protegido por un espigón de piedra.

cases.label: none
cases.why: una entrada apagada sobre un lugar lejano

scope.canon: El grupo se adentró en el bosque de hayas y acampó en un claro junto al arroyo.

entries.content: Un desierto blanco de sal al otro lado de las montañas.
Un bosque antiguo de hayas, silencioso y lleno de claros.

cases.label: change
cases.why: habilitar: el grupo llegó al puente roto

scope.canon: Tras dos días de marcha el grupo llegó al borde del cañón y encontró el puente de cuerdas roto, colgando sobre el vacío.

entries.content: El viejo puente de cuerdas sobre el cañón, roto desde hace años. Sólo quedan los postes.
Un cañón profundo con un río al fondo.

cases.label: change
cases.why: los soldados que llenan la posada se marcharon

scope.canon: Los soldados se marcharon de la Posada del Cuervo al amanecer. La posada está vacía y la posadera por fin puede hablar sin miedo.

entries.content: La Posada del Cuervo está llena de soldados del rey que vigilan a todo el que entra.
Doña Elena regenta la posada desde que murió su marido.

cases.label: none
cases.why: varias entradas, todas al día

scope.canon: Los rescatadores entraron en la mina por el pozo norte. Oyen golpes al fondo de la galería principal: los mineros siguen vivos.

entries.content: La entrada principal de la mina, con un ascensor de madera.
Un túnel largo y estrecho donde quedaron atrapados los mineros tras el derrumbe.
Seis mineros atrapados por un derrumbe al fondo de la galería.
